methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); midstream signals

pit_profile.why: Commodity exposure (Targa Resources Corp. FY2014 10-K): The Partnership’s primary natural gas gathering and processing arrangements that expose it to commodity price risk are its percent-of-proceeds arrangements. Distribution policy: 'even if the Partnership’s business experiences fluctuations in its cash from operations due to seasonal and cyclical factors' (the boilerplate of the cash distribution policy, not a statement that the business is cyclical: the CHTR reading). Risk factor: 'Our cash flow is dependent upon the ability of the Partnership to make cash distributions to us.'; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a midstream natural gas company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution': none names midstream energy; the 10-Ks' 'offshore' is the Gulf of Mexico, they name cloud only as a director's other board, Cloud Peak Energy Inc., and no 10-K names e-commerce or streaming), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here, with the greenhouse gas risk factor: 'The adoption of climate change legislation or regulations restricting emissions of GHGs could result in increased operating costs and reduced demand for the products and services the Partnership provides.' (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY11-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -27.4%/yr (Q1 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 4.5-yr ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS +48.6%/yr (FY11-FY14 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +63.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY14, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: TRGP (retrospective, 2015-06-19) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.03x (-5.2% downside to Bear $94 / +199.8% upside to Bull $268) | Adj composite 2.15 vs market 2.06: gap +0.09 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +5% above the EPP floor $85 (35x FY15E $2.43) | Conservative 2-yr case: +30.0% total (+15.0%/yr) | At 36.8x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $118 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Gathering and Processing -27.5% and Logistics and Marketing +18.7% operating margin in Q1 2015, forward revenues -26.8% (no FY15 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2015 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a midstream natural gas company on this date; none has dated evidence.
